description: This file contains a test runner class for streaming tests in an Orleans-based project. It manages different streaming scenarios such as one-to-one, many-to-many, same grain interactions, and tests for immutability and deactivation behavior. The class orchestrates creation and control of producer and consumer proxies, performs produce/consume operations, and verifies state consistency and deactivation after tests.

classes.name: SingleStreamTestRunner
classes.description: A class designed to run comprehensive streaming tests for Orleans streams, covering various producer/consumer configurations, state validations, and deactivation scenarios.

methods.name: StreamTest_01_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Performs a test with one producer grain and one consumer grain, simulating different join orders.

methods.name: StreamTest_02_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests a scenario with one producer grain and one consumer client object.

methods.name: StreamTest_03_OneProducerClientOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests a scenario with one producer client object and one consumer grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_04_OneProducerClientOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests a scenario with one producer and one consumer client object.

methods.name: StreamTest_05_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple producer and consumer grains with different stream IDs.

methods.name: StreamTest_06_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests multiple producer grains with multiple consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_07_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple producer client objects with multiple consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_08_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests multiple producer and consumer client objects.

methods.name: StreamTest_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains

methods.name: StreamTest_10_ManySame_ManyConsumerGrainsManyProducerGrains

methods.name: StreamTest_11_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests multiple producer grains sharing the same IDs with multiple consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_12_ManySame_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains

methods.name: StreamTest_13_SameGrain_ConsumerFirstProducerLater

methods.name: StreamTest_15_ConsumeAtProducersRequest
methods.description: Tests behavior when producer directly calls a consumer, which subscribes to the producer (deadlock scenario).

methods.name: StreamTest_16_Deactivation_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain

methods.description: Runs a standard produce/process/validate cycle, with optional full testing for multiple series.
